description: First stable portfolio release. Establishes governance stack (evidence-decision-loop + draft-neutral merge intent), restores StoryEngine security hardening and styling work, and introduces versionable peer dependency architecture.
changes: Evidence-decision-loop safe initialization with NEEDS_RECONSTRUCTION and UNKNOWN defaults
Draft-neutral merge intent policy removes GitHub draft status as blocker while preserving 6 blocking markers
Merge-intent infrastructure alignment including test updates and workflow refinements
StoryEngine security consolidation for tenant isolation proof (PR #131)
StoryEngine Studio guard hardening and denial test completion (PR #130)
StoryEngine front door canonical styling and approved hero artwork (PR #136)
Versionable peer dependency manifests in both Chief AI and StoryEngine (.peer-dependencies.json)
Release manifest schema, read-only commit finder, and reconciliation procedures
Portfolio release pinning infrastructure to prevent drift across repositories
